---
applyTo: "packages/genui/a2ui/**"
---

Use `V1FunctionCall` in catalog component contracts so generated v1.0 schemas expose `call`, optional `args`, and optional `catalogId` without the legacy per-call `returnType`. Keep `A2UIFunctionCall` permissive only at runtime boundaries that read v0.9 messages.

When deleting a JSON Pointer that addresses an array element, splice the element and rebuild the nearest parent array's flattened descendant paths. Clearing only the deleted index leaves shifted signals and compact-snapshot paths stale; use the shared JSON Pointer flattening helpers for the renderer and snapshot paths.
